body.value: 藩制一覽表第九（黒羽）
藩制一覧表 第九（黒羽）— 版面右端の柱題（はんせいいちらんひょう だいきゅう・くろばね）

Running header in the outer right margin: Domain Survey Table, ninth fascicle (Kurobane). The nine fascicles are numbered registers rather than data themes; fascicles 8 and 9 hold the officials and military returns. No maru-marker appears anywhere on this leaf, so the header's parenthetical and the data below refer to the same domain. Provenance, not domain data. The 黒 glyph is over-inked and cannot be told from kyujitai 黑 at this resolution.
柱題藩制一覽表第九黒羽
三百八十二
三百八十二（382）
Printed folio number 382, set in the outer margin below the running header. This recto reads first in its opening.
丁付三百八十二
大參事
大参事（だいさんじ）

Senior Councillor (dai-sanji), the ranking domain office under the governor in the post-1869 han administration. One holder is named in the column below. No numeral prints under the heading on this leaf.
大參事
淨法寺頼母
浄法寺頼母（じょうぼうじ たのも）
Jōbōji Tanomo, the sole Senior Councillor. The Jōbōji were a hereditary senior retainer house of Kurobane under the Ōzeki lords.
大參事氏名淨法寺頼母
權大參事
権大参事（ごんだいさんじ）

Provisional Senior Councillor (gon-dai-sanji), the acting or supernumerary grade of the senior councillorship. Two holders are named: Ōnuma Wataru in this same column, and Yanase Tarōbei in the next column to the left, whose heading slot is taken by an editorial variant note.
權大參事
大沼渉
大沼渉（おおぬま わたる）
Ōnuma Wataru, the first of the two Provisional Senior Councillors. The 權大參事 heading stands at the head of this column.
權大參事氏名大沼渉
（午三月屆一ニ三田稱平トス）
（午三月届、一に三田称平とす）（うまさんがつとどけ、いちに みた しょうへい とす）

Editorial variant note in small type, printed at the head of the column of the second Provisional Senior Councillor: in the return submitted in the third month of the horse year (Meiji 3, 1870), the holder is given as Mita Shōhei. The 1928 editors bracket such readings from a differing manuscript witness. The tenth glyph is over-inked; 稱 rather than 稻 is the reading I retain, and the choice affects no figure on the leaf.
校異註午三月屆三田稱平
梁瀨太郎兵衞
梁瀬太郎兵衛（やなせ たろべえ）

Yanase Tarōbei, the second of the two Provisional Senior Councillors. His column carries no office heading, because the 權大參事 heading stands at the head of Ōnuma Wataru's column to the right; the head of this column holds the Mita Shōhei variant note instead.
少參事氏名梁瀨太郎兵衞
少參事（一ニ梁瀨太郎兵衞トス）
少参事（しょうさんじ）（一に梁瀬太郎兵衛とす）

Junior Councillor (shō-sanji), followed by a bracketed editorial variant note reading 'one witness gives this as Yanase Tarōbei'. Two names hang under this rank: Ōtsuka Nizaemon in this same column and Andō Saburōzaemon in the next column to the left. In HI the office heading stands at the head of the first (rightmost) column of its group, and the later columns of the group carry no heading of their own. This heading begins higher up the column than the other three office headings because the bracketed note runs on below it.
少參事
大塚仁左衞門
大塚仁左衛門（おおつか にざえもん）
Ōtsuka Nizaemon, the first of the two Junior Councillors. The 少參事 heading and its bracketed variant note stand at the head of this column.
少參事氏名大塚仁左衞門
安藤三郎左衞門
安藤三郎左衛門（あんどう さぶろうざえもん）
Andō Saburōzaemon, the second of the two Junior Councillors. His column carries no heading of its own, because the 少參事 heading stands one column to the right, at the head of Ōtsuka Nizaemon's column.
少參事氏名安藤三郎左衞門
（以下三行原朱書）
（以下三行、原朱書）（いか さんぎょう、げん しゅがき）

Editorial note in small type: the three lines that follow stand in vermilion ink in the original manuscript. Those three lines are the 權少參事 heading with Andō Kotarō, then Kuno Jūbei, then the closing date line, which is exactly the span the surrounding parenthesis encloses.
校異註以下三行原朱書
（權少參事
（権少参事（ごんしょうさんじ）

Provisional Junior Councillor (gon-shō-sanji). The opening parenthesis printed before the heading has no close in this column; it closes three columns later, after the date line, bracketing the passage the vermilion note refers to. Two holders are named.
權少參事
安藤小太郎
安藤小太郎（あんどう こたろう）
Andō Kotarō, the first of the two Provisional Junior Councillors.
權少參事氏名安藤小太郎
久野十兵衞
久野十兵衛（くの じゅうべえ）
Kuno Jūbei, the second of the two Provisional Junior Councillors.
權少參事氏名久野十兵衞
右午三月屆）
右、午三月届）（みぎ、うま さんがつ とどけ）

Closing line of the roster: 'the above was reported in the third month of the horse year', that is Meiji 3/3 (1870). The closing parenthesis here answers the one opened at the 權少參事 heading, so the vermilion passage runs from that heading through this date.
右午三月屆
兵隊
兵隊（へいたい）

Section heading opening the military return, which in fascicle 9 prints after the officials roster. The column below the heading is empty: no aggregate figure is given here, the strength being itemised in the three columns to its left.
兵隊
銃兵八小隊　一小隊六十人　總數四百八十人
銃兵八小隊、一小隊六十人、総数四百八十人（じゅうへい はちしょうたい、いちしょうたい ろくじゅうにん、そうすう よんひゃくはちじゅうにん）

Riflemen: eight platoons. The two-register warichu below the heading gives the establishment in the right sub-column, 60 men to a platoon, and the product in the left, 480 men in all. Eight platoons at 60 comes to 480, so the printed total reconciles exactly.
銃兵八小隊
豫備銃兵　三十二人
予備銃兵 三十二人（よびじゅうへい さんじゅうににん）
Reserve riflemen: 32 men, held outside the eight line platoons.
豫備銃兵
砲兵　三十六人
砲兵 三十六人（ほうへい さんじゅうろくにん）

Artillerymen: 36 men. This is the gunner count proper. MASTER's doc string records 砲兵45 for this page, which the scan contradicts: 45 is the whole artillery company given in the 但書 to the left, gunners plus officers plus signalmen.
砲兵
但山施條砲六車ヲ編テ一砲隊トシ役員七人號信二人ヲ配置シ都合四十五人
但し、山施条砲六車を編みて一砲隊とし、役員七人・号信二人を配置し、都合四十五人（ただし、やませじょうほう ろくりょうを あみて いちほうたいとし、やくいん しちにん・ごうしん ふたりを はいちし、つごう よんじゅうごにん）

Qualifying note in a two-register warichu: six mountain rifled guns are formed into a single artillery company, to which 7 officers and 2 signalmen are assigned, 45 men in all. The arithmetic closes exactly, 36 gunners plus 7 plus 2 equalling the printed 45. The glyph before 信 is heavily inked; I read 號 (signals), and template matching at matched scale puts 號 ahead of 銃, 通, 鼓 and 傳, though not decisively. Nothing numeric turns on the choice. MASTER's 役員10 is unsupported here: the page prints 役員七人.
但山施條砲六車
